title: Maintenance
no_psql: psql was not found on the web server. Set PGADMIN_PG_BIN_DIR (config/tools.php) to the directory of the PostgreSQL client programs.

about.VACUUM: Reclaims the space of dead rows in every table of the database (VACUUM).
about.VACUUM_schema: Reclaims the space of dead rows in the schema's tables and materialized views (VACUUM).
about.ANALYZE: Collects the planner's statistics on every table of the database (ANALYZE).
about.ANALYZE_schema: Collects the planner's statistics on the schema's tables and materialized views (ANALYZE).
about.REINDEX: Rebuilds the indexes of the database (REINDEX DATABASE), or of the system catalogs only (REINDEX SYSTEM).
about.REINDEX_schema: Rebuilds the indexes of the schema's tables (REINDEX SCHEMA).
about.CLUSTER: Reorders every table that was clustered before on the index it was clustered on (CLUSTER).

help.full: rewrites each table into a new file, which takes an exclusive lock and returns the space to the operating system
help.disable_page_skipping: vacuums the pages the visibility map marks all-visible too
help.skip_locked: skips the tables that cannot be locked at once
help.truncate: returns empty pages at the end of a table to the operating system
help.process_toast: vacuums the TOAST tables as well
help.process_main: vacuums the main tables (switched off, only their TOAST tables)
help.skip_database_stats: leaves the database's oldest transaction ID unchanged
help.only_database_stats: only updates the database's oldest transaction ID, vacuuming nothing
help.index_cleanup: whether the indexes are cleaned of dead rows
help.parallel: workers for the index phase; empty for as many as the indexes allow, 0 for none
help.buffer_usage_limit: the size of the buffer ring used, such as 256kB or 16MB; 0 for no limit
help.concurrently: rebuilds without locking out writes, more slowly
help.tablespace: moves the rebuilt indexes to the tablespace
help.verbose: reports what is done, table by table
